scope: Compare the current real GTK2 engine normal stepper cells directly to the measured Domain/OS SR10.4 HP VUE Trash Can cells at 1:1.

reference.system: Domain/OS SR10.4, HP VUE 2.01, Trash Can

method: Reused the DomainOS-scheme normal capture from the successful private Xvfb GTK2 2.24.33 R490 run. Cropped the four 15x15 cells using native allocations and the canonical VUE coordinates. The right horizontal cell uses x=526 per R329. Compared unscaled RGB pixels directly.
limits: The comparison covers only the normal state. It does not verify held, hover or disabled appearance against VUE.
The capture is a native GTK2 test fixture using the current scheme; it is not a personal application or the live VM.
Color equality is for the DomainOS scheme. Other KDE schemes remain role-derived and were checked against their own generated assets in R488/R490.
next: Keep the normal-state GTK2 stepper geometry; continue only with historical interaction states and the remaining GTK2 review criteria.
